attempts.text:
**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `tmaR`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 2% of calls. The model names 98% of them, at 0.11 bits.

**The rest of the window is fork and variable columns**, 1 to 79, carried by 6 to 90%, in a region of plasticity in 26 to 75% of calls. A branch of 18 shell families runs through columns 1 to 18 in 16%, [[propanediol utilization microcompartments]]. The `cobU` to `cobT` genes, columns 23 to 25, are [[adenosylcobinamide biosynthesis]].

**The model names more genes on the spine column than on the fork and variable ones**, 98% against 81%, and hesitates less there, 0.11 against 0.93 bits. Its most hesitant column, 1, is a fork column, at 2.64 bits.

**The window ends on the `fli` genes**, columns 57 to 70, [[flagellar assembly]]. The last column is `ftnA`, in 9% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 81% of genes**, 0.92 bits on average, perplexity 2.7 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.49 against 0.41 bits, and names fewer genes, 70% against 92%.

label: tmaR
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the tmaR window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor tmaR, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,713 to 1,792 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying tmaR once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 81% of genes, 0.92 bits on average (perplexity 2.7 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 20,437 calls, named 96%, 0.31 bits; shell 20,842 calls, named 73%, 1.32 bits; cloud 1,841 calls, named 18%, 3.10 bits. Outside an RGP 22,852 calls, named 92%, 0.41 bits; inside an RGP 20,268 calls, named 70%, 1.49 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 56 fork, 23 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.49 against 0.41 bits) and names fewer genes (70% against 92%); 20,268 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 1 ("EutP/PduV family microcompartment syste…", a fork column) 2.64 bits, RGP 72%; column 2 (yeeW, a fork column) 2.19 bits, RGP 71%; column 13 (yeeJ, a fork column) 1.24 bits, RGP 67%. The 22 columns (columns 1-22) where most calls are in an RGP: named 82%, 1.17 bits on average; the other 58 columns: named 81%, 0.82 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 98%, 0.11 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 81%, 0.93 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 1, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
